item.title: nerdctl + Tailscale Sidecar Exit Node: A Complete Pitfall Guide
item.author: junyi.h@comp.nus.edu.sg (Junyi Hou)
item.description: In containerized deployments, sometimes you need all outbound traffic from a container to go through a specific network exit. Tailscale&rsquo;s sidecar pattern makes this possible: a Tailscale container acts as a sidecar, other containers share its network namespace, and traffic flows through a WireGuard tunnel via a remote exit node. This setup is well-documented for Docker Compose, but migrating to nerdctl (containerd) introduced a series of pitfalls. Here&rsquo;s what I ran into so others can avoid the same traps.
